header: THE CONTACT RULES OF AN EMPLOYEE RECORD (step 66b; my rules, 1 Nov 2026). PURE. Executive the NIC mail ends with @sail.in, the web-mail with @saildsp.co.in (both optional, the domains are enforced); the one general e-mail field is NOT used. The mobile is the CUG number: ten digits, 94347 and then 9 (the usual) or 2 or 3 (the exceptions) and four digits. Every executive gets one, often later: I made it OPTIONAL when he is added (step 69b); it was required. Non-executive ONE e-mail field, any domain (gmail, hotmail ...), optional; (in rare cases a non-executive has the privilege of a SAIL address: he types it in this one field and it is kept as such). The mobile is any ten-digit number that does not start with 0, optional. WHERE THEY ARE KEPT (the app's own tables): the mobile and the general e-mail are in the employee's LOGIN account (user.contactNo, user.email: what the search cards mask and reveal); the NIC and the web-mail are the roster's own columns (employee_roster.email_nic, webmail_saildsp). The search cards show a mobile as its first six digits and an e-mail as xxxxxx@domain: I make the manager show the same and never a whole number.
